---
name: Model result
about: Share a self-hosted Scientific Worlds result with replay evidence
title: "[Result] "
---

### Model and protocol

| Field | Run configuration |
|---|---|
| Release tag or commit | |
| Model, returned model ID and provider | |
| Agent scaffold and model settings | |
| Condition (M, N0 or F) and world families (S, B or C) | |
| Sampling rule and pre-run commitments | |
| Budgets per session (wall time, tokens, turns, worker CPU and capital) | |

### Outcomes

Give successful deliveries and scored sessions as a fraction. State how many distinct physical worlds were tested, how many attempts were deferred or interrupted, and which sessions repeated a world. For a short development run, include its time and turn caps.

### Replay

Attach the redacted result and replay summary, including terminal phase, delivery and number of replayed actions. Include actual resource use, any provider interruptions and known limitations. Keep private world seeds and API credentials off the issue.
